name: The Mundane
tagline: A regular person with no powers who somehow ended up on a monster-hunting team. Lots of heart, lots of luck, and a knack for being in the right (or wrong) place.
luckSpecial: Each time you spend a Luck point, you stumble onto something weird, and it might even turn out to be useful.

moves.intro: Take every basic move, then choose any three of the Mundane moves below. None come free.

choices.name: Always The Victim
choices.summary: If another hunter shields you with protect someone, they earn experience. You earn experience each time a monster grabs you.

choices.name: Oops!
choices.summary: Tell the Keeper when you would like to blunder into a discovery. You turn up something significant and helpful, though it may have nothing to do with what you are facing right now.

choices.name: Let's Get Out Of Here!
choices.summary: When you protect someone by giving orders or guiding them to safety, use +Charm in place of +Tough.

choices.name: Panic Button
choices.trig: When you need to escape, name the route you will try and roll
choices.full: You get out of danger with no trouble.
choices.part: You can go or stay. Going costs you: something gets left behind, or something tags along.

choices.name: The Power of Heart
choices.summary: When you help someone fight a monster, skip the +Cool roll; your help counts as a 10 automatically.

choices.name: Trust Me
choices.trig: When you tell an ordinary person the truth to keep them safe
choices.full: They follow your instructions without argument.
choices.part: They comply, but the Keeper picks one complication: a tough question first, some dithering and delay, or their own "better" plan.
choices.miss: They think you are crazy and maybe dangerous too.

choices.name: What Could Go Wrong?
choices.summary: When you rush into immediate danger with no safety net, take 2 hold. Spend each hold on one of: +1 harm dealt, 1 less harm taken by someone, or +2 forward when acting under pressure.

choices.name: Don't Worry, I'll Check It Out
choices.summary: Mark experience when you head off alone to look into a frightening place or thing.

items.name: Golf club, baseball bat, cricket bat, or hockey stick
